notes.title: New Bug Cleaning Update
notes.notes:
New Bug Cleaning Update
- Fixed the problem with the game's registration system.
- Fixed the language error problem in the menu.

We will now focus on other bugs and the cashier update.

notes.title: NEW BIG UPDATE
notes.notes:
Hello dear players, as a result of the great potential of our game and the feedback from you valuable players, we have terminated our contract with the game's former developer Mergen Games. Due to the positive feedback we received for our game, we have agreed with a new developer company.
The company we have agreed with is Rilim Gate. Rilim Gate adapted the game to CO-OP gameplay during the process it started developing. We have delivered the first update of this work, which was carried out in order for the game's CO-OP update to come faster and more optimized in the future, on January 13, 2025.
Today, we are pleased to say that we have brought a door-to-door cargo collection update to our game. In addition, the errors in the game have been fixed. Continue to follow us. The cashier update will come soon.
Best regards

notes.title: Door to Door Cargo Collection Update
notes.notes:
Hello dear players, we are sending another update without slowing down. In this update, we focused on cleaning the errors of NPC customers and the errors in the registration system. These errors are no longer present.
We also collect cargo from customers' doors. We go door to door and collect the cargo and bring it to our cargo office. Then we load it onto the truck that arrives in the evening.
See you soon in new updates…

notes.title: FIRST UPDATE OF THE REMAKE (NEW UPDATE ON THE WAY!)
notes.notes:
Hello dear players, the first update of the remake has been completed. It has been sent to you, the players, to be presented. Do not think that the game is complete. An update with missing or new bug fixes will come to the game today or this week.
We are also preparing the cashier and door pick-up update. It will come as an update very soon. Our goal is for the game to receive faster updates now. We have prepared the infrastructure of the game for fast updates and COOP gameplay.
We want to develop the game with you, our valuable players. Therefore, please do not be afraid to share your ideas with us. Finally, if you encounter an in-game error, please let us know.

Best regards

notes.title: Last Announcement
notes.notes:
Hello dear players, as you know, we are redeveloping our game to easily add new content, solve optimization and bug problems. This news is the first share of our game before the update.

We have changed our game from top to bottom. After the first update, we will bring 3 more updates to our game and then we will make our game CO-OP.

Don't forget to write your questions in the comments section of the news.
